snippet.title: Paralives x Unpacking Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Paralives is partnering with Unpacking to offer a free themed game update which will include iconic Unpacking items to decorate characters' houses, playing Unpacking, dressing characters with an Unpacking T-Shirt, and collecting in-game Unpacking stamps. A discounted Steam bundle of both games is also available for fans to purchase! https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
